description: Spotify Ad Analytics image pixels on the root img.byspotify.com endpoint. Checks the pixel key, action, optional ISO currency and populated purchase value. Session identity, placement, deduplication and server-side forwarding requirements need surrounding context.

params.name: key
params.description: The image URL identifies its advertiser pixel with this nonempty key. Numeric and alphanumeric keys remain accepted.

params.name: a
params.description: The published image examples use init, lead and purchase. Unknown actions are advisory because the backend action set is not published.

params.name: value
params.description: A populated purchase value must be numeric. Lead values retain their separate documented representations.

params.name: currency
params.description: The image template names an ISO currency. Membership is advisory; account eligibility is external.

params.name: uid
params.description: Optional on ordinary image pixels. The ssGTM guide describes a hashed session identifier; no digest algorithm is specified.

params.name: alias
params.description: Optional on ordinary image pixels. Internal identity semantics and cross-domain matching are external.

params.name: type
params.description: Lead classification is optional and open.

params.name: category
params.description: Lead category is optional and open.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Optional advertiser order identifier. Repeated purchase detection requires surrounding events.
